structured_summary: The robot announces a package delivery; the recipient must acknowledge it within 8 seconds, after which the robot must confirm the delivery within 1 second.

obligations.source_sentence: The recipient should acknowledge the delivery within 8 seconds.
Once acknowledged, the robot must confirm the delivery within 1 second.

missing_details: modality of acknowledgment (speech, button press, gesture, etc.)
modality of confirmation (speech, LED, sound, etc.)
failure behavior if acknowledgment is not received within 8 seconds
failure behavior if confirmation is not sent within 1 second
precise definition of what counts as an acknowledgment or confirmation
potential_ambiguities: whether the 8‑second window starts at the beginning or end of the announcement
what specific actions constitute an acknowledgment
what specific actions constitute a confirmation
whether the robot should repeat the announcement if no acknowledgment is received
